en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone monument on a rocky hillside above a city. The monument is a tapered, obelisk‑like structure with a statue on top, standing on a pedestal surrounded by low vegetation and pines. In the distance, a broad panoramic view of the city and plain below is visible under a hazy sky. At the bottom of the image there is printed Hungarian text identifying the scene. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, a Hungarian postage stamp and postmark, and a printed publisher's mark.
